SELECT k.id, k.product_model, k.product_category, k.failure_mode, k.issue_source, k.issue_description, k.issue_attachments_id, k.root_cause, k.permanent_action, k.action_attachments_id, k.application_scene, k.role, k.create_time, k.update_time, COALESCE(cs.completion_status, 0) as completion_status, issue_file.file_name as issue_file_name, issue_file.file_url as issue_file_url, action_file.file_name as action_file_name, action_file.file_url as action_file_url FROM knowledge_info k LEFT JOIN completion_status cs ON k.id = cs.knowledge_info_id AND cs.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN file_info issue_file ON k.issue_attachments_id = issue_file.id LEFT JOIN file_info action_file ON k.action_attachments_id = action_file.id WHERE
k.role LIKE CONCAT('%', #{role}, '%')
ORDER BY k.create_time DESC
